title: One roti, more sharers
description: Two round rotis of equal size sit side by side. The left roti is divided vertically into two equal halves, with the left half colored blue and the right half showing plain baked dough. The right roti is divided into four equal quarters, with the top-left quarter colored amber and the remaining three quarters plain. Below the left roti is the label "Shared by 2", and below the right roti is the label "Shared by 4". Centered beneath both rotis is the question "Which share is bigger?".

title: Two sharers or four sharers
description: Two round rotis of equal size appear side by side. The left roti is divided vertically into two halves, with the left half tinted blue and labeled '2 children' on the left. The right roti is cut into four equal quarters, with the top-left quarter tinted amber and labeled '4 children' on the right. Below, the blue half piece and the amber quarter piece sit side by side, flanked by '1/2' on the left and '1/4' on the right. Centered at the bottom, a label reads '1/2 is more than 1/4'.

title: One fifth or one ninth
description: On the left, two round rotis of the same size are stacked one above the other. The top roti is divided into five equal slices, one coloured blue, labelled "5 sharers". The bottom roti is divided into nine equal slices, one coloured amber, labelled "9 sharers". On the right is a large copy of those two pieces: the blue one-fifth slice, with the amber one-ninth slice laid over it as a see-through piece with a thick amber outline, the tips together and the right straight edges lined up, so the whole blue slice shows through and a strip of it is left uncovered on the left. The fraction "1/5" stand...

topic_name: Fractional Units as Parts of a Whole
title: A chikki piece in fourths
description: A rectangular piece of peanut chikki is scored into a grid of 24 equal squares, 6 across and 4 down. Two dashed grey lines, one vertical down the middle and one horizontal across the middle, divide it into 4 equal blocks of 6 squares each. The 6 squares of the top-left block are tinted blue, and "6 squares = 1/4" is printed to the left of the grid. The other 18 squares, which make an L shape, carry no tint: each one has a thick near-black border with a thin pale edge, so the real peanuts and caramel show through, and "18 squares = 3/4" is printed to the right of the grid. Centred below the gri...

topic_name: Fractional Units as Parts of a Whole
title: One strip of the chikki
description: On the left, a whole chikki is shown as a grid of 24 small squares arranged in 4 rows and 6 columns, divided by two vertical lines into 3 equal upright strips of 8 squares each. Each strip is 2 squares wide and 4 squares high with a blue outline, labelled above with '1', '2', and '3'. To the right, one matching strip of 8 squares stands separately with an amber fill and outline. Beside it, the text reads '1 strip = 1/3'. Centred at the bottom, an equation reads '3 × 8 = 24 squares'.

title: A strip folded in half
description: At the top, a strip folded in half is shown as a double layer with its ends meeting, labeled underneath with "fold: ends meet". Below it, the opened strip is divided into two equal parts by a vertical grey crease in the middle. The left half is coloured blue and labeled "1/2 unit" directly below it, while the right half is coloured amber. A thin horizontal bracket spans the entire bottom edge of the opened strip, with the equation "1/2 + 1/2 = 1 unit" printed centered underneath it.

title: Collecting half rotis
description: Three groups of rotis appear in a row on a white background. On the left, a single half roti with a blue outline is labeled "unit:" above "1/2 roti". In the middle, three identical half rotis with blue outlines appear in a line separated by grey "+" signs, with "1/2 + 1/2 + 1/2" and "3 × 1/2 roti" printed below. On the right, two half rotis with amber outlines are joined to form one full circular roti, positioned next to a separate half roti with a blue outline. Below this group is the text "1 roti and" above "1/2 more".

topic_name: Marking Fraction Lengths on the Number Line
title: A line of one half
description: A grey horizontal number line is divided from 0 to 2 by five evenly spaced vertical tick marks. Three ticks are labelled below: "0" at the start, "1" at the centre under a thicker reddish purple tick, and "2" at the right end, with unlabelled ticks halfway between "0" and "1" and halfway between "1" and "2". A thick blue line segment rests on the number line, running from "0" to the first tick mark. Above this segment sits the text "1/2 unit". An amber rectangular bracket spans above the line from "0" to "1", topped by the text "2 equal gaps make 1 unit".

topic_name: Marking Fraction Lengths on the Number Line
title: Two lines in fifths
description: A grey horizontal number line runs from 0 to 2, marked with eleven evenly spaced ticks that divide each unit into five equal parts. The labels "0", "1", and "2" appear below the line at their respective tick marks. Above the line, two horizontal bars begin aligned with "0". The lower blue bar extends over two intervals to the second tick, indicated by a grey dotted vertical drop line, and is labelled "2/5" to its right. The upper amber bar extends over four intervals to the fourth tick, with a dotted line dropping to the tick and the label "4/5" beside it.

topic_name: Fractions Greater than One and Mixed Numbers
title: Before one or past one
description: A horizontal grey number line runs from 0 to 2 with three vertical ticks labelled '0', '1', and '2' below the line. The middle tick mark at '1' is drawn thicker in reddish purple. A light blue rectangular band shades the interval between '0' and '1'. Two circular dots rest on the line: a blue dot placed two-thirds of the way between '0' and '1', and an amber dot placed halfway between '1' and '2'. Directly above the blue dot is the text '2/3 is less than 1', and directly above the amber dot is the text '3/2 is more than 1'.

topic_name: Fractions Greater than One and Mixed Numbers
title: One cup too many
description: A tall straight-sided glass on the left is divided horizontally into three equal sections by two thin grey lines, with all three sections filled with blue liquid to the brim. Below this glass is the printed equation '3/3 = 1'. In the centre is a dark blue plus sign. To the right stands a cup of the same width, one third the height of the tall glass, filled to the brim with amber liquid and labelled '1/3' beneath. Centred at the bottom, a rounded reddish purple outline box displays the inequality '4/3 > 1'.

title: Three strips, one length
description: Three horizontal strips of equal length are stacked vertically with aligned edges. The top strip is divided into two equal parts with the left part shaded blue and the right part unshaded. The middle strip is divided into four equal parts with the two left parts shaded amber and the remaining two unshaded. The bottom strip is divided into eight equal parts with the four left parts shaded reddish purple and four unshaded. A grey dashed vertical line marks the halfway point through all three strips where the shading ends. To the right of each strip are the fractions "1/2", "2/4", and "4/8". Belo...

title: One roti, three facts
description: A round roti on the left is divided into four equal quarter pieces separated by thin white gaps. Three pieces show a golden-brown baked texture with brown spots, while the top-right quarter is tinted blue. A thin grey horizontal arrow with a round dot at its base extends from the blue quarter towards the right, passing beside a large fraction '1/4'. To the right, three number sentences are stacked in dark blue: '1 ÷ 4 = 1/4' on the first line, '1 = 1/4 + 1/4 + 1/4 + 1/4' on the second line, and '1 = 4 × 1/4' on the third line.

title: Many names for one half
labels: bottom number is twice the top
description: Three round watermelon slices sit in a row, each cut in half by a vertical reddish purple line. The first slice is divided into eight equal wedges, with four blue wedges on the left and four red on the right, labelled '4/8' below. The second slice has ten equal wedges, with five blue on the left and five red on the right, labelled '5/10'. The third slice has twelve equal wedges, with six blue on the left and six red on the right, labelled '6/12'. Along the bottom, printed text reads 'each one = 1/2' and 'bottom number is twice the top'.

title: Saplings in groups of four
description: Centered near the top is the fraction 16 over 20 in dark blue. Directly beneath it sits a horizontal row of five rounded grey boxes, each enclosing four saplings to make twenty saplings in total. The sixteen saplings across the first four boxes are filled in blue, while the four saplings in the fifth box are uncoloured outlines. Underneath the row, two lines of text read '4 of 5 groups watered' and '5 groups of 4'. At the bottom, a pink-purple outlined box displays the equation '16/20 = 4/5'.

title: One half in eighths
description: Two rectangular chikki bars of equal length are stacked one above the other, each divided into eight equal pieces with peanut textures. In the top bar, the first four pieces are tinted blue and separated from the four plain pieces by a thick black dividing line, with '1/2 = 4/8' printed to the right. In the bottom bar, the first five pieces are tinted amber and the remaining three are plain, with the fifth piece outlined in purple, and '5/8' printed to the right. Centred below the bars is '4/8 < 5/8', with 'same unit: eighths' printed underneath.

title: Two glasses in twentieths
description: Two identical straight-sided glasses stand side by side, each marked into 20 equal horizontal levels. The glass on the left has its bottom 15 levels filled with blue liquid, labelled to the left with '4 children:' and '3/4 = 15/20'. The glass on the right has its bottom 14 levels filled with amber liquid, labelled to the right with '10 children:' and '7/10 = 14/20'. A dashed reddish purple horizontal line extends across both glasses level with the top of the blue fill. Centred below the glasses, the text reads '15/20 > 14/20' above 'same unit first'.

title: Half and fourth of chikki
description: A horizontal peanut chikki bar is divided into four equal rectangular pieces. The first two pieces on the left are shaded with a translucent blue overlay, grouped by a reddish-purple bracket below the label "Meena: 1/2 = 2/4". The third piece is shaded with an amber-yellow overlay under a reddish-purple bracket beneath the label "brother: 1/4". The fourth piece on the far right is unshaded, showing the natural peanut and jaggery texture. Centred below the bar is the equation "1/2 + 1/4 = 3/4" written in dark blue with vertical fraction bars.

title: A glass of lassi in twelfths
description: An upright rectangular glass is divided into twelve equal horizontal levels. From the bottom, the first three levels are filled with solid blue, the next four levels are filled with solid amber, and the top five levels remain empty white. A purple bracket spans the seven filled levels on the right. To the right of the bracket are two lines of text: "water: 1/3 = 4/12" above "curd: 1/4 = 3/12". Centred below the glass and labels is the addition equation "1/4 + 1/3 = 7/12".

title: Taking away chikki pieces
description: A rectangular chikki bar is divided into seven equal square parts. The first two parts on the left contain blue chikki pieces, with a reddish purple bracket beneath the first piece labelled "1/7". The next four spaces are shown as empty dashed outlines, and the seventh space is an empty solid outline. To the lower right, four amber chikki pieces of the same size sit together in a horizontal row, labelled to their left with "4/7 to Joseph". Below them, text reads "same unit: 1/7". At the bottom, a centred equation reads "6/7 − 4/7 = 2/7".

title: Fourths and thirds in twelfths
description: Two horizontal strips of equal length are stacked vertically. The top strip is divided by solid lines into four equal parts, each subdivided by grey dashed lines into three parts, making twelve equal parts in total. Its first eight parts are blue, the ninth is purple, and the last three are white. To its right is printed "3/4 = 9/12". The bottom strip is divided by solid lines into three equal parts, each subdivided by grey dashed lines into four, making twelve equal parts. Its first eight parts are amber and four are white, with "2/3 = 8/12" to its right. Below both strips is the equation "9/...

topic_name: A Pinch of History and the Unit Fraction Puzzle
title: Bhinna, the broken whole
description: On the left, a cream card with a thin dark outline displays the digit "1" positioned directly above the digit "2" with no dividing line between them. Beneath the card is the label "ancient India, around 300 CE". To the right, a round roti is split vertically into two equal halves separated by a narrow gap; the left half is shaded blue, while the right half is baked tan. Centred below are two lines of text: "bhinna means broken" and "bhaga, ansha: part, piece".
